cues: Rigid numbered template: Classification and constraints, Dependencies, Key decisions, First end-to-end slice (Phase 0), Phases, Validation checks, Cross-cutting concerns, AI layer, Exceptions, Deferred
Budget table labels every number REQUIREMENT / ASSUMPTION / BASELINE / UNKNOWN and names the check (V#) that verifies it
Decisions table with reversibility grades (R1/R2/R3), default, assumption, validated-by, and 'what would flip it' columns
Numbered validation checks V0–V7 with hypothesis, method, acceptance threshold, evidence, unlocks/if-fails, and phase; V0 is a walking-skeleton slice
Boilerplate sections such as 'AI layer: N/A', 'Exceptions: None', 'Not applicable' list, and 'Things this plan will not change (each with cost to change)'
